summary: This directory is dedicated to the testing infrastructure for verifying the merging logic of API components, ensuring that parameters, return values, summaries, and tags are correctly consolidated during update operations.
responsibilities: Validate the correctness of merging logic for API definition components.
Ensure consistent behavior when aggregating parameters and tags during updates.
Verify accurate propagation of summaries and return value definitions.
relationships: Merge logic is validated by testing specific API components like parameters, returns, summaries, and tags.
Test cases ensure that updates to API documentation remain consistent across all metadata types.
designDecisions: Isolated testing of merge operations per component type.
Focus on component-specific property aggregation during updates.
